reviews.comment: Attend class, do the practice exam, and you will be just fine. actually teaches in lectures and works practice questions. exams are very doable. coding questions a little tricky.
He just made the class worse than it should be. Didn't really explain the concepts clearly and avoided any questions students have. Exams didn't made any sense and found the homework a waste of time.

Dr. Kwon's lectures weren't always directly relevant to the homework, but he was very accessible outside of class. As long as you take the time to read parts of the textbook (as needed) and take good notes, the class is straightforward.

Professor Kwon is a terrible lecturer. It was evident that he lacks the ability to explain the most simple questions. His lectures are pretty unorganized and doesn't really help with the exams and homework. Before the final exam he refused to go over some practice problems that were very crucial.

reviews.comment:
Pros: Provides detailed formula sheets during exams, lenient grader, and provides a huge curve at the end of the semester.

Cons: Sloppy and unorganized lecture slides, unable to provide adequate responses to questions asked during class, provides inadequate assistance for difficult homework problems, lectures super quickly.

Ok professor overall.

CHEN 461 during Fall Semester. Prof Kwon lectures well. Loves making jokes. Homeworks are challenging. Reach out to prof, TA, and textbook. Exams are fine. Similar to the Homeworks but simpler. Final exam was difficult, think I got just over 50%. Final Project is fun. Reach out to prof, TA, and textbook. Said to give ~35% A's, ~35% B's, rest C's.

Not a good lecturer, and assumed we knew everything already. Homeworks were very long/difficult -  so much so that at one point no homeworks were graded in 2.5 months. Exams were pretty difficult also, but the saving grace is that he gives a lot of partial credit. Final exam is gg 30 mc questions in 2 hours but final grade definitely gets curved.

Easy grader, gives a lot of partial credits on exams, but not a good lecturer. Not very helpful during office hours either. Homeworks are very difficult and time consuming, and you pretty much have to teach yourself everything. 30-question final in two hours.
